summary: Full UI + API validation of Between Visit Phase 18 (Create route from 3D scan). All 12 requested checks pass. Routes page shows 'Create from 3D scan' with correct data-testids and gating (file input + Upload button disabled, scan-file-gate hint shown while scan-empty-space-checkbox unticked; both enable and hint disappears when ticked). Client-side: .txt rejection shows 'Choose a .glb, .ply or .obj file.' in scan-upload-error. Server-side rejections: empty.glb -> 'This file has no 3D geometry we can use.', fake.glb -> "We couldn't read this file as a 3D model. Export it again as .glb, .ply or .obj." (both stay on /routes). corridor.glb upload navigates to /scan/{id}; scan-facts: 'Measured size: about 11.9 × 7.8 m, 2.6 m high', '150,001 points · colours from texture', unit=metres (detected), up=+y (detected). room_cm.obj detects cm with 'about 4.2 × 3.1 m, 2.5 m high'; switching scan-unit-select to metres rescales the size text (becomes '420 × 305.2 m' at m). room_zup.ply detects +z (metres); Turn upright cycles the up axis (observed +z -> -z). Placement UI on corridor.glb: pointer-down + drag on canvas created placement-point-1 (Entrance, x=1 z=5.5, facing 36°); clicks added placement-point-2 and -3; placement-point-2-distance showed '4.9 m from the Entrance'; placement-add-ahead-button added a 4th point; placement-undo-button removed it (3 again); keyboard edit of placement-point-2-x-input to 3.5 propagated; placement-point-2-remove-button removed it; placement-confirm-button disabled with blocker 'Place at least one checkpoint after the Entrance.' when only Entrance placed. Confirm placement -> 'Checkpoint pictures' heading, scan-render-status cycled through 'Rendering and checking picture N of 3…' and ended with 'Pictures ready. Check each one, replace it with a photo if you like, then approve.'; each checkpoint-{N} card has a rendered checkpoint-{N}-photo and 'Suggested by AI' badge; cards have NO Move up / Move down / Remove buttons (0/0/0 vs 3/3/3 on a normal route builder); scan-save-button disabled with scan-save-reason 'Approve every checkpoint to save (0 of 3 approved).' until all approved; after approving all three Save produces scan-saved 'Saved version 1 with the 3D scan (uploaded by practitioner).' and the route appears in /routes. scan-cancel-button on an unsaved scan deletes the scan and returns to /routes; the cancelled route names (TEST_phase18_cm, TEST_phase18_zup) do not appear in /routes. Regression: /routes still shows 'Create route' and 'Teach by walking' forms; the saved scan route's /routes/{id} builder still shows 3 Move up / 3 Move down / 3 Remove buttons on its 3 checkpoints. Backend API: POST /api/scans empty_space=false -> 422; filename .txt -> 415; size>100MB -> 413; valid create -> 201 and GET matches. GET /api/routes/{saved_route_id}/memory returns the memory v1 with Entrance at x=0,z=0 and label '3D scan (uploaded by practitioner)'. Checkpoints: Entrance position [0.0, 0.0, 0.0].

critical_code_review_comments: ScanRoute.jsx cancel flow: axios.post(/cancel) uses .catch(() => {}) which silently ignores backend failure. If cancel 500s, the user is still routed to /routes while the scan session remains 'placed'. Low priority since the server-side cancel is robust, but surfacing a toast on failure would be safer.

ScanStartForm.uploadScan swallows the per-chunk error, calls /cancel, then rethrows — if the user cancels mid-upload (e.g. tab close), nothing cancels the server-side scan session. The 6h sweep in sweep_scan_files handles it eventually, but a sendBeacon on unload or an explicit cancel UI during upload would be nicer.

renderViews fallback catch sets 'Couldn't render the pictures in this browser. Use Take photo or Upload photo for each checkpoint.' but does NOT create empty cards — users on a no-WebGL browser will see 0 cards and no obvious path to proceed. Consider still loading the empty checkpoint list and letting Upload photo attach manually.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 18 is fully compliant. Important for next testing: (1) Canvas interaction with the Scene3D placement works in headless by using page.mouse.down() + .move() + .up() over the canvas (pointerdown at ~45%/75% of the canvas rect reliably hits the corridor floor and places Entrance). Short mouse.click() calls on different floor regions reliably add checkpoints (OrbitControls stays disabled during the drag). (2) The 'Approve' button text toggles to 'Approved' after click, so re-locating via text requires skipping already-approved cards — use data-testid="checkpoint-{N}-approve-button" directly. (3) Render + AI landmark takes ~15-20s total for 3 checkpoints (Sonnet). (4) The saved scan route 6b25bc2e-73ef-461f-b2b8-5e6e03a4a8e1 should be deleted by the main agent. No other cleanup needed.
